permissions.description: Call WebAir's semantic API (a fictional demo airline): search flights, read fare rules, request a booking quote and, only with the separate purchase permission, simulate a purchase.

Read the travel profile you choose from your memory (home airport, preferred cabin, nonstop preference) when a request leaves those unstated. The profile becomes search criteria sent to WebAir; it is never shown to a model as a profile.
Read the passenger identity you choose (name and contact email) and send it to WebAir for a booking quote or a simulated purchase, and nowhere else. No model sees it.

Read which payment method you choose (an opaque demo identifier and a display label, never a card number) and send the identifier to WebAir with a simulated purchase, and nowhere else. No model sees it.

Simulate purchasing the one exact quote a task names, with the payment method you choose. Fictional: WebAir performs no real transaction and charges nothing. Consequential by design: grant it once, for one run.
Use the host-selected model router to interpret the request, choose fares and write the answer.
Read and write explicit worker state views for this run only.
After a booking, propose things to remember: the seat you chose, a changed home profile. Nothing is written until you accept each proposal after the run.
